name: The Skewed Arcade

detectability.signature: Parallel star-rows bending at mutually inconsistent angles, as if the sky were built of crooked columns

proximity: Parallax measurements disagree by whole degrees between instruments
Navigation instruments give contradictory readings that worsen with each pass
contact: Straight-line courses curve visibly without any felt acceleration
Two ships flying abreast measure steadily increasing distance between themselves
prolonged_exposure: Crew lose the ability to judge angles and distances even after departure
Return courses reliably deliver ships somewhere else inside the zone

phenomena: Objects appearing larger or smaller than they are
hazards: Persistent spatial disorientation lasting long after departure
opportunities: Chance to test exotic theories of geometry
known_incidents: The cartographic frigate Straight Answer spent ninety hours inside and emerged needing new charts and new navigators
A geometry cult pays handsomely for interior recordings, which induce splitting headaches in most viewers
description: Within the Skewed Arcade, straight lines are a local custom rather than a law. Starlight arrives bent at angles that contradict their neighbors, so the sky resolves into rows of leaning columns receding toward horizons that never close. The zone spans nearly a third of an astronomical unit and reshuffles its internal arrangement every nineteen hours.

Each pulse re-deals the geometry: corridors of flat space open between regions where parallel beams converge. Ships entering on rigid headings find themselves sailing arcs they never steered. Distance proves equally unreliable, for a kilometer measured bow to stern may measure ten abeam.

No natural process comfortably explains a region where the parallel postulate takes holidays, and no known builder claims the work. The first systematic survey was abandoned after its navigators, once returned, kept drawing floor plans of places no one had ever been. It endures as a pilgrimage site for mathematicians with more courage than caution.

Traffic controllers route shipping around the Arcade's margin, whose pulse timing is published but imperfectly trusted. Boundary stations auction observation time to geometry-hungry institutions. Everyone agrees the zone is survivable; few agree on how to leave it deliberately.
